theorem Roth.le_index_of_forall_eval_eq_zero.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {r : σ → ℕ},
      (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
        ∀ (α : σ → ℝ) {c : ℝ},
          (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (∀ (j : σ), d j ≤ r j) → Roth.weight r d < c → (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) P) = 0) →
            c ≤ Roth.index P α r :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {P} hP {r} hd α {c} hvan ↦
  (Roth.le_index_iff hP).mpr fun d he ↦
    le_of_not_gt fun hw ↦
      he
        (hvan d
          (fun j ↦
            Decidable.byContradiction fun h ↦
              he
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (eval α) _a = 0)
                      (hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_degreeOf_lt (LE.le.trans_lt (hd j) (Eq.mp not_le._simp_1 h)))))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = 0) (map_zero (eval α)))) (Eq.refl 0))))
          hw)

CUTOFF252_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {r : σ → ℕ},
      (∀ (j : σ), degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
        ∀ (α : σ → ℝ) {c : ℝ},
          (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (∀ (j : σ), d j ≤ r j) → Roth.weight r d < c → (eval α) ((hasseDeriv d) P) = 0) →
            c ≤ Roth.index P α r
